minor.issue: ProjectOut Pydantic model does not include `is_demo`, `client_name`, or `project_type` — so ProjectMemory.jsx cannot render the DEMO tag or the 'Acme Corp · Dashboard Design' subtitle (both fall back to 'Client · Project'). The demo project has all three fields in Mongo but they get filtered out by ProjectOut's `extra='ignore'`.

ui_bugs.issue: DEMO tag never renders because backend ProjectOut model filters out is_demo. Requirement in review: 'shows... DEMO tag'. Fix: add `is_demo: Optional[bool]=None`, `client_name: Optional[str]=None`, `project_type: Optional[str]=None` (and ideally `demo_tag`) to ProjectOut in /app/backend/models.py.

action_items: Add is_demo, client_name, project_type (and demo_tag) fields to ProjectOut in /app/backend/models.py so ProjectMemory.jsx can render the DEMO tag and Client · ProjectType subtitle.
critical_code_review_comments: connectors.py is now 1665 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Split the demo seed (~200 lines) and cross-source ask/notifications block into separate modules.
DELETE /api/demo/reset — the review request called for POST /api/demo/reset. The implementation uses DELETE. Works fine but naming/verb mismatches the spec.

ProjectOut model uses extra='ignore' which silently drops fields the UI needs — every new project field must be added to ProjectOut or it won't reach the client (this is the root cause of the DEMO-tag bug).

_demo_memory() emits one item with category='scope_change' and one with category='deadline' — those are legacy categories that go through _canonical_category(). Works but the seed should ideally use the canonical categories directly (scope, timeline).

rca of the issue: DEMO tag missing: ProjectMemory.jsx line 109 renders `{project?.is_demo && DEMO}`. The `project` state comes from `api.get('/projects/${id}')` which returns a ProjectOut Pydantic model. ProjectOut (models.py:50-96) declares neither `is_demo` nor `client_name` nor `project_type`, and its ConfigDict(extra='ignore') silently drops these fields even though they exist on the demo project in Mongo. Fix: add `is_demo: Optional[bool] = None`, `client_name: Optional[str] = None`, `project_type: Optional[str] = None`, `demo_tag: Optional[str] = None` to ProjectOut in /app/backend/models.py. Reproduction: login as demo user → open Acme project → header shows 'Client · Project' instead of 'Acme Corp · Dashboard Design' and no DEMO tag. Backend verified via curl: GET /api/projects/{id} does NOT include is_demo/client_name (dropped by model).
